facts.value: The city says no surviving record supports any theory of the school's origin earlier than 1410, although Ono no Takamura and Ashikaga Yoshikane are both named as founders.
facts.quote: existing records cannot support any theories prior to the year 1410

facts.value: The school drew about 3,000 students from across Japan around 1550, and Francis Xavier wrote of it in 1549 as the largest university in eastern Japan.
